decisions.quote: Consistent with the findings of Carney et al., our results showed a significant effect of power posing on self-reported feelings of power. However, we found no significant effect of power posing on hormonal levels or in any of the three behavioral tasks.
decisions.reason: The authors explicitly identify self-reported feelings of power, hormones, and financial risk taking as the three outcome measures of Carney et al. (2010) and frame their results across the Introduction, Results, and Discussion as replicating the effect on self-reported feelings of power while failing to confirm the effects on hormones and risk taking, which is mixed under the codebook.
